body: CHANGELOG updated in emily.cli: fix(iduna): Client.Auth() now fetches a fresh JWT on every call instead of reusing a cached one until its exp claim says <5min left -- fixes UNAUTHENTICATED errors from a token invalidated some other way mid-run (e.g. across an iduna.service restart) (sess-20260813-2154-dda37e8b)
